ui.teamBridge.scope: 3-key delta (ui.teamBridge.chief.unnamed, message.sending, message.failed; new). The other 111 values were NOT re-audited here; only checked for 114-key parity with English. Checked: meaning vs en context rows, core glossary and ru style guide, register vs neighbours chief.fallback, chief.label, composer.error, composer.placeholder_to, people.message, thread.*, {person} placeholder intact and grammatical, ellipsis style, NFC, no bidi/zero-width controls. Values: 'Координатор: {person}', 'Отправка…', 'Не отправлено'. Term matches chief.fallback and intro_chief ('координатором'). PROBLEM with chief.unnamed: see finding. No rendered-fit, screenshot or pseudo-localization evidence is claimed; the 30px rail fit is judged by string length only.

findings.issue: 'Координатор: {person}' reads as 'Coordinator: Ivan', i.e. {person} is the coordinator, inverting the meaning (the person is the OWNER of the chief of staff). It also produces a doubled colon in the composer placeholder / people.message, which are 'Написать: {name}' -> 'Написать: Координатор: Иван', and is inconsistent with sibling chief.label '{agent} ({person})' that marks the owner in parentheses.
findings.suggestion: Координатор ({person}) — mirrors chief.label and the fr rendering, keeps the name in the nominative so no declension is needed, and avoids the second colon.
